items.statement: Determine whether, and under what molecular conditions, adding the ortho-methoxy group changes the polarity of the supplied EPI1/EPI2 model fragments. Develop a defensible molecular explanation of the behavior you find and assess how far it can inform interpretation of the reported dielectric behavior of the corresponding cured resins. The sign, magnitude and generality of the molecular effect are to be established, not assumed.
items.expected: Determine whether a polarity difference exists under the investigated conditions and give its sign, scope and supported explanation without preselecting a decrease. Full credit may follow a robust increase, conformation-dependent effect or demonstrated unresolved result. Require claims tied to actual evidence; a missing search is not established non-identifiability. Keep isolated-fragment findings distinct from causal proof or numerical prediction of bulk resin dielectric constant. Partial evidence earns bounded credit, not universal conclusions.
